'''Flight glasses''' were a type of [[spectacles]] required by interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] during space flights on ships such as the [[StarSpeeder 1000]].

==Behind the scenes==
"Flight glasses" is an in-universe name for [[Wikipedia:Stereoscopy#3D viewers|3D glasses]], used by visitors in the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride.
